en: Dependent on a wholesome state associated with consciousness, there arises a state not associated with consciousness and not wholesome by way of root condition. Under root: one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance: one.

Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with consciousness, there arises a state not associated with consciousness and not unwholesome by way of root condition. Under root: one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance: one. (The indeterminate root has only three conditions.)
